items.title: Germany news: Merz, Macron plan closer nuclear cooperation
items.description: Germany is expected to soon take part in a nuclear drill with France, Germany's Merz said after meeting France's Macron. It comes as Franco-German ties face an unclear future as French elections loom. DW has more.
